title: Simulation-Informed Diffusion for Decentralized Multi-robot Motion Planning
abstract: arXiv:2605.27697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decentralized multi-robot motion planning requires each robot to generate collision-free trajectories from local observations, without global sensing or reliable communication. However, most existing planners, whether classical or learning-based, generate trajectories from a static snapshot of the local observation, which limits their ability to anticipate the future behavior of neighboring robots. This limitation is critical as the number of robots increases and the environment becomes more cluttered. Motivated by world models that use future state estimation to improve planning decisions, this paper introduces Simulation-Informed Diffusion (SID), a decentralized framework built on constraint-aware diffusion models (CADM) that simulate neighboring robots' future trajectories to guide each robot's own planning. translated_title: 面向去中心化多机器人运动规划的仿真引导扩散方法
translated_abstract: 去中心化多机器人运动规划要求每个机器人在没有全局感知或可靠通信的情况下，仅依靠局部观测生成无碰撞轨迹。然而，大多数现有规划器——无论是经典方法还是基于学习的方法——都仅基于局部观测的静态快照来生成轨迹，这限制了它们预测相邻机器人未来行为的能力。随着机器人数量增加和环境变得更加拥挤，这一局限性变得尤为突出。受世界模型利用未来状态估计来改进规划决策的启发，本文提出了仿真引导扩散，这是一个建立在约束感知扩散模型之上的去中心化框架，通过模拟相邻机器人的未来轨迹来引导每个机器人自身的规划。SID首先使用CADM根据当前观测到的状态模拟相邻机器人的未来轨迹……
tldr: 本文提出仿真引导扩散（SID），一个基于约束感知扩散模型的去中心化多机器人运动规划框架，通过模拟相邻机器人的未来轨迹来引导每个机器人的自身规划决策，从而克服了传统方法基于静态观测快照、无法预判邻居未来行为的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Simulation-Informed Diffusion (SID), a decentralized multi-robot motion planning framework built on constraint-aware diffusion models that simulates neighboring robots' future trajectories to guide each robot's own planning, overcoming the limitation of existing planners that rely on static snapshots of local observations.
